# each student follows alone in Word on the lab computer, as fast as

```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you make a short notice in **Word** on the lab computer. Do the tasks
in order. The **orange numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick
the box `#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with Word. **Nothing to download:** you type
  the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your Word may look a little different: the
  names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · Open Word and type the notice

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Search* on the taskbar #mk(1). Type *word*. Click *Word* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-open-1.png", w: 88%, left: 32%)
#step(2, [Click *Blank document* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-open-2.png", w: 42%, left: 32%)
#step(3, [Type these five lines. Press *Enter* at the end of each line.], after: typebox[
  #set text(size: 12pt)
  #set par(justify: false, spacing: 0.75em)
  Book Fair \
  When and where \
  Sunday to Tuesday, 10:00 to 15:00, in the college library. \
  Entry is free. \
  Prices
])
```

## Task 2 · A title and headings (styles)

A **style** gives a line a ready look with one click: **Title** for the name
of the document, **Heading 1** for a heading.

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click in the line *Book Fair* #mk(1). On the *Home* tab, in *Styles*, click *Title* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-styles-1.png", w: 88%)
#step(2, [Click in *When and where* #mk(1). Click *Heading 1* #mk(2). \ Then click in *Prices* #mk(3) and click *Heading 1* again.], img: "images/lab-styles-2.png", w: 88%)
#step(3, [Click the *View* tab #mk(1). Tick *Navigation Pane* #mk(2). \ Your headings are now on the left #mk(3). \ Then click the *Home* tab again.], img: "images/lab-nav-1.png", left: 32%)
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 3 · Center, bold and a colour

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click in the title *Book Fair* #mk(1). Click *Center* #mk(2). \ The whole line moves to the middle.], img: "images/lab-format-1.png")
#step(2, [Double-click the word *free* #mk(1): it is now selected (blue). \ Click *B* (Bold) #mk(2). \ Click the small arrow next to *A* #mk(3), then click *red*. \ Only the word _free_ changes.], img: "images/lab-format-2.png", w: 92%)
```

## Task 4 · A table of prices

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click at the end of the line *Prices*. Press *Enter*.])
#step(2, [Click the *Insert* tab #mk(1). Click *Table* #mk(2). \ Move the mouse over the squares: *2* across and *4* down. The list says *2x4 Table* #mk(3). Click.], img: "images/lab-table-1.png", w: 80%)
#step(3, [Type the table. Press *Tab* to go to the next cell.], after: typebox[
  #table(columns: (4cm, 3cm), inset: 6pt, stroke: 0.6pt + luma(90), fill: none,
    [*Book*], [*Price (JD)*], [Novel], [3], [Dictionary], [5], [Notebook], [1])
])
```

## Task 5 · Fix the spelling and save

```{=typst}
#step(1, [A *red wavy line* under a word? It is a spelling mistake. \ Right-click the word #mk(1). Click the right word #mk(2). \ No red line? Good: go to step 2.], img: "images/lab-spell-1.png", w: 92%, left: 32%)
#step(2, [Press *F12* (on a laptop: *Fn + F12*). The *Save As* window opens. \ _Or:_ click *File*, *Save As*, *Browse*.])
#step(3, [Click *Desktop* #mk(1). \ In *File name*, type *book-fair-* and your first name #mk(2). \ Click *Save* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-save-2.png", w: 94%, left: 32%)
```

## Show your teacher

```{=typst}
#block(breakable: false, grid(columns: (0.9fr, 1.1fr), column-gutter: 14pt, align: top,
  shot("images/lab-result-1.png"),
  [
    #set par(spacing: 0.9em, justify: false)
    Your notice now looks like the picture. Check it:
    #v(4pt)
    #tick #h(4pt) *Book Fair* is big and in the middle. \
    #tick #h(4pt) The pane on the left shows 3 headings. \
    #tick #h(4pt) Only the word *free* is bold and red. \
    #tick #h(4pt) The table has 2 columns and 4 rows. \
    #tick #h(4pt) The file is on the Desktop.
    #v(8pt)
    #tip[Raise your hand: your teacher looks at your screen. \ Then do the *Extra*: AI changes your notice.]
  ],
))
```

## Extra · AI changes your notice

```{=typst}
#block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#f4f2fb"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#b9a7f7"), radius: 6pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt))[
  Only when you finish Tasks 1–5. An *AI assistant* opens your Word file and changes it for you. We use *ChatGPT*; Gemini, Claude and Copilot work the same way.
]
#step(1, [Open the browser. Go to *chatgpt.com*. Sign in: *Continue with Google*, or with your *Microsoft* (university) account.])
#step(2, [Click the round button at the left of the box #mk(1) (on some screens: *+*). \ Click *Add photos & files* #mk(2). \ Click *Desktop*, click your file *book-fair-…*, click *Open*.], img: "images/lab-ai-1.png", left: 30%)
#step(3, [Type this request and press *Enter* #mk(1): #h(4pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#b9a7f7"), radius: 4pt, inset: 6pt)[Make the title blue. Add a row to the table: Magazine, 2. Give me the new Word file.] \ #v(2pt) Click the new file in the answer #mk(2). It downloads.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-ai-2.png", w: 92%)))
#step(4, [Open the new file: click it at the top of the browser (*Downloads*). It opens in Word. \ The title is blue, and the table has a new row!])
#step(5, [One more? Type: #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#b9a7f7"), radius: 4pt, inset: 6pt)[Add a heading About the fair and two short sentences for students. Give me the new Word file.]])
#tip[The AI answers with text, not a file? Copy the text, and paste it into your notice in Word.]
```
